notes.title: OverShoot will become free
notes.content:
[h3]Hi Folks,[/h3]

     [h3][b]OverShoot Battle Race will become a free to play game.[/b][/h3]

     During 3 years of development and another 3 years with constant updates, new features, and improvements, always listening to the community and people who play, the game will become free.

     My goal when creating this game was never to get rich, I've always dreamed of recreating a game like Rock'n Roll Racing because I played it in my childhood with my best friend, and always brought me really good memories. 

     Often I caught myself wondering about bringing this same feeling to other people and being able to recreate this happiness again by playing something that I created with my own hands.

     It was a lonely, painful, and expensive journey until I reached this point of maturity in the game, I learned, I grew as a game developer, and I'm proud of the game, nonetheless,  the game didn't get as far as I wished and, for some reason, the game fell into a STEAM limbo and was not advertised, making no one be noticed that the game even exists, and what I wish with my entirely harth is that people play and have fun with OverShoot.

    For those and other reasons, the game will become FREE TO PLAY soon, this change will not affect any game mechanics but the official servers will be shut down as soon as the game becomes free, nonetheless, this does not mean that the game will no longer support multiplayer, you can still playing multiplayer with your friends by starting some server or hosting you own server wherever you wish.

    For the people who bought OverShoot, my eternal gratitude.

    For the people who helped me to test this game, you are part of this game's history.

    [h3][b]Finally, FREE means FREE, the game will not have any in-app purchases, cosmetic items, or any pay-to-win mechanic.[/b][/h3]

Regards
Arthur - OnlineObject

notes.title: Added support for MOD's ( v1.0.141 )
notes.content:
[h2] It is with great pleasure I announce that OverShoot Battle Race now supports user modification ( MODs).[/h2]

[h3]As the first version, users may find some limitations but we work hard to allow a considerably large list of modifications.  The allowed current modification is:[/h3]
[h3]- Customize SoundTrack[/h3]
[i]     Select any sound file existent on your PC ( MP3 and WAV )[/i]
[h3]- Customize Narration[/h3]
[i]     Record and replace the narrator speaks[/i]
[h3]- Replace vehicle 3D models[/h3]
[i]     Replace any vehicle model with a custom 3D model ( Obj file )[/i]
[h3]- Replace character's names and photos[/h3]
[i]     Replace game characters with any custom name or photo[/i]
[h3]- Modify race Game Speed[/h3]
[i]     Increase or decrease the speed of racing to get more dynamicity[/i]

[h3]I'm planning to include allowing more modifications in the future. But I need your help to bring this game to the sunlight. [/h3]

[h3]A detailed document and video about how to create MOD files will be available on my youtube channel and OnlineObject website.[/h3]

[h3][url=http://www.onlineobject.net]www.onlineobject.net[/url][/h3]
[h3][url=www.youtube.com/@OnlineObject]OnlineObject Channel[/url][/h3]
